title: Verify: Header loading, error, retry, empty and icon control unit tests
summary: Unit tests cover each pill state and the icon controls.
description: New test file asserting REQ3 criteria with the real uiStore.
acceptance_criteria: Loading, error, retry and empty pill state tests pass.
The sound and settings icon test changes the real uiStore and passes.

steps.action: Create tests: (1) render <HeaderOverlay worldTitle="W" loading />; expect getByTestId('round-pill') data-state loading, text Loading round…, queryByRole('timer') null. (2) render with error="Round service returned 500" and onRetry=vi.fn(); expect pill data-state error, getByRole('alert') text 'Round unavailable: Round service returned 500'; click button Retry; expect onRetry called once. (3) render with nothing; expect data-state empty and 'No active round'. (4) beforeEach useUiStore.setState({soundEnabled:true,settingsOpen:false}); render with roundFixture; within getByRole('group',{name:'Header controls'}) click Toggle sound and Settings; expect store soundEnabled false and settingsOpen true.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/headerKitStates.test.tsx tests/headerOverlayStates.test.tsx tests/headerRetry.test.tsx tests/headerOverlayControls.test.tsx
steps.expected: New and existing header state tests pass.
